id.description: Plan id; verdicts are stored under <state dir>/pipeline/<id>/.

tier.description: From `factory-pipeline.py tier`; an override is named in the report. XS = prose-only one-task plan within registry pipeline.tiers.XS.

topic.description: Integration branch <type>/<area>/<topic>, the same in every repo; task branches are <topic>-<task id>.

deliver.description: pr: the user authorized push + gh pr create once the gate is READY_FOR_PR. Merge stays with the user.

no_worktree_markers.description: Repo-relative marker files replacing the pipeline defaults for this plan.

known_failing.description: Checks that already fail at the task base. `validate` warns; lead and QA specs carry them: a failure of a listed check that also fails at the base is FAIL_AT_BASE, not a task FAIL; a listed check that now passes is reported as fixed.

repos.description: Repos that are not in the registry (e.g. a tool or plugin repo), or overrides of the base.

path.description: Absolute, or relative to the plan file.

repo.description: Registry repo key or a key of plan.repos.

paths.description: Owned paths (repo-relative); disjoint from every task it does not depend on.

resources.description: pipeline.exclusive_resources ids the task needs (repos listed there imply it)

worktree.description: true is rejected for a repo with worktrees: false

orca_run.description: The task lead's own Orca Run id (from its report; run:<id> accepted). status and cleanup list that Run's settled workers that are not released (read-only worker-list). Not part of the verdict fingerprint.

reason.description: Explains an implementer override or placement choice.

grade.description: Model grade of the task (registry pipeline.models.rubric). Default: derived from its tier (S light, M standard, L or contract/generated paths heavy). Its implement sessions run with the grade's profile; a heavy task's review runs with the heavy profile.

grade_reason.description: One line: why this grade (the rubric sentence it matches).
